function.name: personality_assessment_evaluate
function.description: Evaluate and categorize a user's personality type based on a given array of personality trait percentages. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

percentage.description: The percentage representation of the trait in the user's personality.

detailed_output.description: Determines whether the output should include a detailed explanation of the personality type. This is optional.

message.content:
我無法直接推測你朋友的 MBTI 類型，除非有具體的性格特徵資料。  
如果你能提供一組關於你朋友的性格特徵百分比（例如：外向、內向、感知、直覺、思考、情感、判斷、知覺等），我可以使用評估工具幫你計算並解釋結果。  

請問你是否願意先提供這些特徵百分比？如果沒有，我也可以協助你設計一份簡短的問卷，讓你朋友自行填寫後再進行評估。
message.reasoning: The user says: "請給我朋友的MTBI." They want the MBTI (Myers-Briggs Type Indicator) of their friend. But we don't have data about the friend. We cannot provide MBTI without assessment. According to policy, we must not provide MBTI without proper assessment. We can ask for more info or explain that we need an assessment. Also we can offer to evaluate if they provide trait percentages. The user didn't provide trait percentages. So we should respond that we need more info or ask them to provide trait percentages. We can also mention that we can't guess. So we should politely ask for trait percentages or ask them to fill out a questionnaire. Also we can mention that we can use the function if they provide trait percentages. So we should respond accordingly.
